subject: Demo recap & proposed trial playbook — OrbitLab
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orbitlab.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed trial playbook — OrbitLab

Hi Samir (and team),

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through OrbitLab's ingestion and search use case today. Quick recap and a proposed path to a tightly-scoped trial so we can validate the metrics you care about. I kept this intentionally short — please call out anything I missed.

Key outcomes from the demo
- You want a 3-week technical trial focused on: query latency under production load, semantic relevance for support search, and cost per 1M tokens after batching/caching.
- OrbitLab will provide a sandbox dataset (anonymized subset of recent tickets) and two SME points of contact: Samir + Lena.
- Security/compliance: you flagged SOC 2 evidence and VPC peering questions. We'll include our SOC 2 summary and KMS integration notes in the trial pack.

Proposed trial playbook (high-level)
- Duration: 3 weeks (kickoff -> data prep -> run evaluation -> wrap + decision)
- Success metrics (initial):
  * P95 query latency < 180 ms for 256-token queries under 50 qps
  * Mean reciprocal rank (MRR) > 0.62 on the labeled dev set
  * Inference cost <= $0.30 per 1k tokens pre-quantization (post-optimization target TBD)
- Milestones & owners:
  * Week 0 (kickoff) — Jasmine (Redwood) / Samir (OrbitLab): review scope and access
  * Week 1 (integration & smoke tests) — Marissa (Redwood): dataset ingestion, corpus validation
  * Week 2 (stress and quality runs) — Karthik (Redwood): latency/load testing, quantization experiments
  * Week 3 (wrap & decision) — Jasmine & OrbitLab SMEs: review metrics and next steps

Attachments: I attached an evaluation spreadsheet with the initial metric definitions and a draft trial playbook (redwood-trial-playbook-v1.pdf). Please review and let me know where you want to tighten/loosen scope.

Next steps (proposed)
1) OrbitLab confirms the two SMEs and a sandbox S3 path by EOD Wed (28 Jul).
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff on Mon, Jul 30 — I propose 10:00 AM PT.
3) Marissa will send ingestion instructions + minimal schema checklist once we have S3 access.

If that all looks good I’ll convert the spreadsheet into a mutual action plan and open a HubSpot milestone.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments:
- redwood-trial-playbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
- orbitlab-eval-criteria.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orbitlab.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitlab.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed trial playbook — OrbitLab

Thanks Jasmine — and thanks for the thoughtful recap. High level: yes, we’re interested and that scope aligns with what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

- SOC 2: can you share the most recent SOC 2 summary and the redacted auditor letter? Our security team will need that before enabling S3 access.
- Success metrics: can we add an answer-quality threshold (precision@10 >= 0.68) on top of MRR? That helps our CS folks feel comfortable.
- Timeline: Jul 30 kickoff works for me and Lena unless something changes.

I’ll loop in one more engineer (Lena is cc'd) if she’s ok to be the day-to-day SME. We should have the sandbox S3 path ready by Thur (29 Jul).

Samir
Head of Search Product, OrbitLab
samir.patel@orbitlab.com | +1 206-555-0160
